<h1>Modifier buttons</h1>

MSEQ uses 6 LaunchControl XL buttons as modifiers. These can be held alone or in pairs, and the combination decides what a pad press does in the current view.

## Physical layout

The 6 are in two different places on the unit. Buttons 1–4 are the **function column** down the right-hand edge, labelled Device / Mute / Solo / Record Arm on the panel. Button 1 is called SHIFT throughout these pages, because that is what it does here. Buttons 5 and 6 are the two buttons in **column 8 of the 2×8 button grid**, one above the other: the column that would otherwise be sequencer 8's mute and autodrop.

<img src="/assets/mseq/lc-buttons-layout.svg" alt="Diagram of the Launch Control XL button layout: a two-by-eight grid of buttons named 1A to 7A across the mutes row and 1B to 7B across the autodrop row, with column 8 outlined and named 8A and 8B as the two modifiers; beside it a four-button function column holding SHIFT (panel label Device), MUTE, SOLO and REC ARM; and beside that a photograph of that column on the rig, four square rubber buttons lit pink under stage lighting, labelled Device, Mute, Solo and Record Arm from top to bottom" style="display:block;margin-inline:auto">

*The photograph on the right is that column as it is actually labelled. SHIFT
is the button the panel calls **Device**: worth knowing before you go
looking for a shift key that is not there. The Hold indicator beside it and the
bracket down the side are Novation's factory-mode markings and do nothing under
the MSEQ templates.*

The buttons only speak to MSEQ once a user template is loaded onto the unit: see
[LaunchControl knobs and faders](/documentation/MSEQ/lc-knobs) for the templates and what each one
addresses.

## What each modifier does

Buttons can be held in pairs as well as alone. Not every pair does something
different: an unlisted pair behaves as though only the first button were held.
8A and 8B pair only with each other.

| Button held | trig view behaviour |
|--------|---------------------|
| *(none)* | Toggle step ON/OFF |
| SHIFT | Toggle step to percentage chance |
| MUTE | Toggle step to trig mute |
| SOLO | Set sustain start/end points |
| REC ARM | Mod-chance increment: OFF → MOD1 → MOD2 → MOD4 → MOD8 → MOD16 → OFF; an INVMOD step converts back to its matching MOD |
| 8A | Inverse mod chance, and INVMOD back to the matching MOD |
| 8B | **Euclidean trig overlay**: pressed step sets rotation |
| SHIFT + MUTE | Reset row (clear trigs + Euclidean overlay) |
| SHIFT + SOLO | Randomise row (random-density trig fill) |
| SHIFT + REC ARM | *(reserved)* |
| MUTE + SOLO | *(reserved)* |
| SOLO + REC ARM | *(reserved)* |
| 8A + 8B | Full mod → inv-mod increment cycle (MOD1 … MOD16 → INVMOD4 … INVMOD16 → OFF) |
